fix(styles): Use html.dark selector for dark mode

This change correctly scopes the dark mode background and text color styles to elements within an `html.dark` parent. This prevents potential conflicts and ensures styles are applied only when the dark mode is active.

style: Refactor color palette and animations

This commit updates the application's color scheme to a more vibrant orange and yellow palette, replacing the previous green and amber. It also refines several CSS animations, including:

- Shortened the 'shake' animation for a snappier effect.
- Adjusted the 'pop-in' animation duration for better visual flow.
- Updated the 'glow' animation colors to match the new palette.
- Applied new colors and animations to keyboard keys and tiles for a cohesive look.
- Enhanced accessibility by updating focus ring colors.
- Improved layout responsiveness for the game screen by using viewport height.

feat: Add visual feedback for game end states

Introduce animations and styling to visually indicate when the player wins or loses. This includes:

- A `fade-to-gray` animation for the game board when the game is lost.
- Modified winning tile animations to use `animate-jump` and `animate-glow`.
- A `shakeScreen` state to trigger a screen shake animation upon losing.

feat: Add badge system and animations

Introduce a badge system for achievements and new animations for a more engaging user experience.

- **Badge System:**
    - Define `BadgeTier` and `Badge` types.
    - Implement `checkAndUnlockBadges` logic in `badgeService`.
    - Integrate badge unlocking and display in `DailySummaryModal`.
    - Update `formatShareText` to include newly unlocked badges.
- **Animations:**
    - Add 'glow' and 'shimmer' animations to Tailwind CSS configuration in `index.html`.
    - Apply 'glow' animation to winning tiles in `GameScreen.tsx`.
- **UI Adjustments:**
    - Modify `App.tsx` and `GameScreen.tsx` for better layout and flex behavior.
    - Adjust `body` styling in `index.html` to maintain scrolling while disabling pull-to-refresh.
    - Update `SettingsScreen.tsx` for consistent layout.
    - Refactor `DailySummaryModal` to handle badge logic and state.

feat: Add PWA install prompt

Integrates functionality to prompt users to install the Progressive Web App (PWA).

This change introduces a new hook `usePwaInstall` to manage the PWA installation logic, including detecting the `beforeinstallprompt` event and handling user interactions. A new component `InstallPwaPrompt` is created to display the prompt to the user. The main `App` component is updated to conditionally render this prompt.

The prompt is designed to provide platform-specific instructions for installation (e.g., "Add to Home Screen" for iOS). The prompt can be dismissed by the user and will not reappear after dismissal.

feat: Enhance PWA capabilities and theme

This commit introduces several improvements related to the application's presentation and offline experience.

Key changes include:
- Adding a `manifest.json` file and setting `theme-color` for better PWA integration and app icon theming.
- Updating the viewport meta tag to prevent user scaling and improve mobile display.
- Integrating the 'Cairo' font for Arabic language support, enhancing readability for Arabic users.
- Implementing `overscroll-behavior: none` on the html and body elements to disable pull-to-refresh behavior and ensure a smoother user experience.
- Streamlining the main `App.tsx` layout to use flexbox for full screen coverage and hide overflow.
- Correcting import paths for types and hooks across various components to properly utilize the root re-exported types and settings hook.
- Updating the `Keyboard` component to handle Arabic language display and add a `specialKeyText` prop for more flexible rendering.
- Adding a `solutionDefinition` prop to the `GameModal` for displaying the meaning of the guessed word.

feat(game): Add winning animation and language support

Introduce a new "jump" animation for winning tiles, enhancing visual feedback upon game completion.
Implement dynamic keyboard layouts to support different languages, starting with English and Turkish.
Add a randomize button to the header for practice mode.
Update tile and game board components to integrate the new animation and provide game state information.

feat: Initialize İslami Wordle project structure

Sets up the basic project configuration, including Vite for building, React for UI, Tailwind CSS for styling, and TypeScript for type safety. Defines initial app structure with screens for home, game, and settings, along with essential constants and utility types. Includes placeholder files for future service implementations and component development.
Initial commit

feat: Configure build for shared hosting deployment

Update Vite configuration and add cPanel deployment script to ensure the application builds correctly for deployment on shared hosting environments like cPanel. This includes setting the correct base path, build output directory, and asset directory, and providing a deployment task for copying built files.

feat: Enhance image generation with 4K and Stability AI

Improve image generation quality by explicitly requesting 4K resolution and adding support for Stability AI as an image generation model.

This change updates the Gemini system instruction to include 4K resolution and best quality requirements. It also introduces a new state variable and handler for Stability AI API keys in the settings, and adds 'sd3' to the available image models in the AI generator component.

feat: Integrate Flux and Grok image generation

Adds support for generating images using the Flux model via Pollinations, and introduces Grok AI integration.

This update enhances the AI generation capabilities by allowing users to choose between Gemini, Flux, and Grok models for image creation. It also refactors the `geminiService` to include new functions for interacting with Flux and Grok, and updates the `AiGenerator` component to accommodate these new options. Additionally, it adds support for OpenRouter API keys in the `SettingsView` for broader AI model access.

feat: Improve API JSON payload and dependencies

Update import map to use latest stable versions of React and Vite plugins.
Modify the 'get_all' API endpoint to decode the 'tags' JSON string into an array for easier processing by Android clients.
Add Retrofit implementation details to the API Preview component for Android developers.

feat: Remove Supabase integration and add custom API support

This commit refactors the application to remove its direct dependency on Supabase for data storage and authentication.

Instead, it introduces support for a custom API endpoint, allowing users to specify their own backend service URL. This provides greater flexibility in data management.

Key changes include:
- Removing Supabase client library and related authentication logic.
- Updating API preview component to generate PHP code for a custom backend.
- Modifying state management in App.tsx to check local session storage for authentication.
- Streamlining the login screen to focus on local admin credentials.
- Refactoring the SettingsView to manage custom API endpoint URL instead of Supabase credentials.
- Adjusting storageDB utils to work with local storage or a custom API.

feat: Integrate Supabase for cloud storage and authentication

This commit introduces Supabase as a backend service for the application.
Key changes include:

- **Authentication:** Replaced the simple local password authentication with Supabase email/password authentication. The application now checks for both local session and Supabase sessions upon startup.
- **Cloud Storage:** Enabled cloud saving of media items to Supabase Storage. A fallback to local IndexedDB is maintained in case of cloud save failures.
- **Configuration:** Added fields for Supabase URL and Key in the settings view.
- **Error Handling:** Improved error messages for Supabase-related issues, guiding users on potential RLS configurations.
- **Session Management:** Implemented functions for getting and signing out of Supabase sessions.

This integration provides a more robust and scalable solution for data persistence and user management.

feat: Use dedicated function for Supabase config

Refactors Supabase configuration handling by introducing a `getSupabaseConfig` function. This centralizes the logic for retrieving Supabase URL and Key, prioritizing local storage settings over defaults.

This change improves code maintainability and consistency across components that interact with Supabase. It also ensures that the API preview and settings views correctly reflect the current Supabase configuration.

feat: Improve Android code generation with better placeholders

Updated the placeholder text for Supabase URL and Key in the Android code generation to be more descriptive and guide users to the correct settings. Also, added dependency information to the generated code for easier integration.

feat: Integrate Supabase for cloud storage

This commit introduces Supabase integration as an optional cloud storage solution. Users can now configure Supabase credentials in the settings to store media items remotely.

The `ApiPreview` component has been updated to reflect the potential use of cloud storage.

The `utils/storageDB.ts` file now consolidates storage logic, prioritizing Supabase if configured, otherwise falling back to IndexedDB.

A new `services/supabaseClient.ts` file handles Supabase client initialization, configuration checks, and file uploads.

feat: Migrate storage to IndexedDB

Removes Supabase dependency and implements local IndexedDB for storing media items.
This change simplifies storage management by relying on browser-native capabilities.

feat: Integrate Supabase for data storage

Replaces IndexedDB with Supabase for robust backend data management. This change introduces Supabase client integration, allowing for persistent storage and retrieval of media items.

Includes:
- Supabase client setup and configuration.
- Data mapping between application models and Supabase table schema.
- Refactoring of data access logic to use Supabase queries.
- Updates to `package.json` and `index.html` for new dependencies and CDN paths.
- Enhancements to filtering logic in `Dashboard.tsx` to handle potential null tags.
- UI elements for Supabase configuration in `SettingsView.tsx`.

feat: Implement IndexedDB for media storage

Integrates IndexedDB to persist media items locally. Adds utility functions for database initialization, fetching all items, saving new/updated items, and deleting items.

The `AiGenerator` component now uses `onSave` with a promise, and `App.tsx` loads existing media from the database on initialization. Mock data has been removed, and a UUID generator utility is introduced for unique item IDs.

feat: Introduce multi-app support and Gemini AI context

Implement functionality for managing multiple application profiles, allowing users to define distinct contexts for AI metadata generation. This includes:

- **AppProfile Interface:** Defines structure for app name, description, and AI context keywords.
- **State Management:** Update `AppState` to include an array of `AppProfile` objects and an `activeAppId` for switching between them.
- **Gemini AI Contextualization:** Modify `generateMediaMetadata` in `geminiService.ts` to incorporate the `aiContext` from the active `AppProfile`, enabling more tailored AI suggestions based on the application's focus (e.g., 'cat, kitten, feline' for a cat wallpaper app).
- **UI Enhancements:**
    - Add an app switcher dropdown to the `Sidebar` component.
    - Update the `Dashboard` to filter media items by the currently active application.
    - Integrate `activeApp` context into the `UploadModal` for relevant AI generation.

feat: Add settings view for API key management

Introduces a dedicated settings view allowing users to input and save their Gemini API key. This change includes:

- A new `SettingsView` component.
- Integration of the settings view into the sidebar navigation.
- Updates to `geminiService.ts` to retrieve the API key from local storage or environment variables.
- Refinements to `App.tsx` to check for the API key's presence and update the `hasApiKey` state accordingly.
- A new `settings` view option in `AppState`.

feat: Add AI creative prompt generation

Introduces functionality to generate creative prompts for AI image and video generation. This enhances the user experience by providing starting points for media creation. Updates `package.json` to use any version of `@google/genai`.

fix: Downgrade React to v18.2.0

Downgrades React and related dependencies from v19 to v18.2.0 to ensure compatibility with the current project setup and external CDN imports.

feat: Update dependencies and project name

Updates project name from "wallpapers-admin" to "purrfect-admin".
Refactors Vite configuration to correctly handle environment variables and removes unnecessary alias.
Upgrades various dependencies to their latest compatible versions.
Adjusts TypeScript configuration for modern ES features and better project setup.

feat(AiGenerator): Add media download functionality

Introduces a download button to the AI generator component, allowing users to directly download generated wallpapers and videos. This enhances the user experience by providing a convenient way to obtain AI-created assets.

feat: Enhance Gemini AI wallpaper generation quality

Upgrades the `gemini-3-pro-image-preview` model to generate 2K resolution wallpapers with an enhanced prompt for hyper-realistic and detailed results. Includes cinematic lighting, ray tracing, and professional photography attributes.

feat: Initialize project with Vite and React

Sets up the project structure using Vite and React, including necessary dependencies, TypeScript configuration, and build tooling. Configures Tailwind CSS and custom styling for the application's base theme. Includes a README with local development instructions.
Initial commit
